target.strategy: Reuse the generalized analysis engine after the Gotaleden refactor is finished; keep ÖST acquisition, provenance and event-specific normalization in this repository.

primary_input.rule: The generic engine should consume the curated analysis layer, not recrawl Sportstiming. The frozen archive remains source truth/provenance and is used to rebuild the curated layer when normalization changes.

invariants: Never fabricate checkpoint passages, status, rank, route geometry, age, gender, relay structure or cross-year identity.
Keep raw source identifiers and labels alongside semantic normalization.
A race family is not a course version. Cross-year course comparison is gated by verified geometry evidence.
Trace de Trail public geometry diagnostics may establish comparability but are not automatically redistributed as route assets.
Duo inherits the same-year Ultra route/course version.
Duo member source_sequence is source-backed; leg_no remains nullable until ordering is independently validated.
Bengtemölla is the canonical named checkpoint for 2022/2023. The preceding 32 km observation remains a separate approach/prewarning candidate.
Feature availability is data-driven through reports/engine-readiness.json and the curated database.
Exact age is never derived from an age-category interval.
Cross-year person identity must be a separate confidence-bearing linkage layer and must not overwrite source-local identity.

tables.races: 34 held race-year instances with event/race/course metadata.
tables.participants: Source-local individual result identities. No cross-year identity is implied.
tables.relay_teams: Duo team identities and source-backed team category where published.
tables.results: One normalized result row per imported Sportstiming athlete/team result.
tables.splits: Only observed/published split passages; includes individual Ultra and parsed Duo team splits.
tables.relay_members: Published Duo member rows with source_sequence; leg_no may be NULL.
tables.derived_metrics: Source-derived metrics such as Bengtemölla between-observation/service-window candidates.

field_recovery_policy: Start number may be recovered from exact Sportstiming list headers including Startnr. when missing in the normalized detail row.
Club and country may fall back to the corresponding frozen result-list columns.
For individual 2022 results, explicit Kategori forms such as F40-44 or M45-49 may populate sex and age_category.
Do not infer exact age from category ranges.
Do not infer sex/age from names in years where the public source does not expose them.

race_catalog.purpose: Display/source metadata for each race-year instance.

courses.rule: Only expose a route asset when a locally usable route source exists. Geometry-comparison evidence alone does not satisfy this requirement.

races.rule: course_version may be null while historical geometry remains unresolved; frontend features requiring route data must then be disabled.

checkpoints.rule: Keep non-primary timing observations in provenance/source data even when analysis_boundary=false.

records.rule: FINISHED rows require a positive finish time; non-finish rows may legitimately have no finish_seconds.

splits.rule: Only published/observed passages are emitted. No interpolation belongs in the source split table; interpolation happens in the frontend replay model.

teams.rule: Team/member structures are now parsed from the frozen public source. source_sequence is preserved; leg_no must remain null unless later evidence validates leg ordering.

elevation.rule: Use one common smoothing/resampling method for cross-year D+/profile comparisons; raw dense barometric sums are not authoritative.

duo60.split_source: parsed frozen Sportstiming team detail tables

feature_gating.frontend_rule: Hide or explain unavailable features instead of rendering empty or fictional analyses.

known_current_pattern.ultra60: Finish/result and split analysis are ready for every held year. Replay/map additionally require local route assets; currently 2024-2026 qualify.
known_current_pattern.duo60: Team finish results and real team splits are parsed for every held Duo year. Published member rows are retained. Replay/map currently qualify for 2024-2026; leg assignment stays disabled.
known_current_pattern.trail22_trail14_trail5: Finish/result analysis is ready. No intermediate split tables were found in the complete imported public result details, so replay/split features stay off unless stronger source evidence appears.

identity_policy.source_identity: participant_uid is race-result-local and does not assert that matching names across years are one person.
identity_policy.repeat_runner_analysis: Build a separate documented linkage layer with a person_key, confidence/evidence and ambiguity handling; never overwrite source identity.
identity_policy.historical_field_gaps: Sex/age are intentionally absent where not explicitly published in the frozen source.
